vagas.titulo: AI Assistant User – Weekly Feedback Study
vagas.descricao: We're looking for everyday users of Meta Muse or Instinct who have used the app for at least 2 weeks. Each week you'll keep using the assistant across different parts of your life (at least 3, e.g. work, health, errands, social), then log and rate the proactive messages it sends you. You'll also export your weekly conversations with personal details removed. This is an ongoing study with the same group of raters each week.

About the project
Agentic-MME tests whether AI models can investigate an image rather than just look at it. To solve a task, the model has to crop, rotate or enhance the image so a small detail becomes readable, then search the web for a fact, and then check each against the other before answering.

What you'll do

- Use high-resolution images where the key detail is small or degraded to test frontier AI models on the raw image and find what they miss, then build tasks around those gaps
 
- Write realistic prompts that need image work and at least one web search
 
- Record the shortest solution path step by step, with the image operations used and a credible source for each search
 
- Give one exact golden answer, a clear answer format and any accepted variants

What we're looking for

- Strong attention to detail
 
- Excellent writing skills
 
- Skill at web research, with a habit of using primary, authoritative sources
 
- Advanced degree holders
 
- Experience working on rubrics is a plus but not a must-have

About Turing:
 Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

 Role Overview: 
 As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.

 Key Qualifications 
 • English Proficiency: Ability to read and write in English with a high degree of comp, as English is the focus language for this project.
 • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
 • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
 • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
 • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
 • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
 • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
 • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
 • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
 • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
 • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
 • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.

 Description: 
 • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve:
 • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
 • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
 • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
 • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic "overnarrating".
 • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
 • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
 • Extracting and verifying "Debug Info" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
 • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.

 Education & Experience 
 • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
 • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.

 Offer Details: 
 • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and upto 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
 • Engagement type: Contractor
 • Engagement Length: 3 months
 Evaluation Process -
 • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form .
 • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours .
 • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements .

About Turing:
 Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

 Role Overview 
 We are seeking an analytical researcher and red-teaming specialist to build evidence-based web-research benchmark tasks that reliably expose weaknesses in state-of-the-art (SOTA) AI models (e.g., Claude Opus 5 Max). In this role, you will discover hard-to-surface facts, build precise research tasks around them, test them directly against leading LLMs, and diagnose the exact failure mechanisms in the model's search and reasoning paths.
 Your work will directly shape AI evaluation frameworks, ensuring next-generation frontier models are tested against rigorous, non-trivial real-world research scenarios.

 Job Requirements: 
 • Core Experience: 1+ years in investigative research, fact-checking, AI benchmark task authoring, red-teaming, or technical QA review.
 • Benchmark Familiarity: Proven experience authoring, testing, or reviewing tasks for AI benchmarks such as GAIA, BrowseComp, SimpleQA, SWE-bench, Terminal-Bench, or Humanity’s Last Exam (HLE) .
 • Analytical & OSINT Skills: Intermediate-to-advanced web search and Open Source Intelligence (OSINT) skills; ability to navigate academic archives, local records, or obscure databases.
 • Model Trajectory Debugging: Strong analytical capability to inspect model reasoning chains, search logs, and source selection to diagnose root causes of failure.
 • Precision Writing: Ability to author clear, unambiguous benchmark prompts with bulletproof, primary-sourced answer keys.
 Job Responsibilities: 
 • Obscure Fact Discovery: Deeply research niche topics to identify factual ground truths that cannot be surfaced via simple, direct search queries.
 • Source Verification: Rigorously verify facts against primary or highly credible sources, cross-check for contradictory evidence, and document exact source URLs.
 • Task Construction: Draft clear, answerable benchmark tasks designed specifically to expose structural weaknesses in model research strategies.
 • Red-Teaming & Model Testing: Execute tasks against designated SOTA models to confirm they reliably trigger intended model failures.
 • Failure Diagnosis & Debugging: Trace model run logs, search trajectories, and intermediate outputs to pinpoint exactly where and why the model failed (distinguishing genuine model limitations from ambiguous prompts).
 • Pattern Scaling & Review: Apply validated "model-breaking" research patterns across new domains and, for strong performers, review tasks authored by peer trainers.

 Strong Plus (Preferred Qualifications) 
 • Bachelor or higher degree from relevant engineering domain is a must for this position.
 • Prior experience specifically designing prompt-injection or reasoning-trap tasks that break SOTA models.
 • Advanced OSINT capabilities or published investigative/academic research demonstrating deep source verification.
 • Niche domain expertise in areas rich with hard-to-find records (e.g., local government filings, regional sports history, legal archives, historical patents).
 • Experience serving as a lead reviewer, benchmark auditor, or quality owner on AI evaluation projects.
 Offer Details: 
 • Commitments Required: Upto 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
 • Engagement type: Contractor
 • Engagement Length: upto 4 weeks
 Evaluation Process -
 • Candidates will be require to submit a Job Interest Form & assessment .
 • Talents finalized in assessment will go through assessment, review & will proceed further accordingly.

About Turing

 Role Overview 
 A US based AI company that is at the forefront of AI research is looking for a Team Lead to oversee a team of business analysts. This opportunity is tailored for professionals who have experience in leading teams and has interest in supporting the development of solutions at the cutting-edge of technology.

 Job Responsibilities

 • Provide direct, constructive feedback to trainers and recommend corrective actions when quality issues are identified.
 • Document recurring error patterns and contribute to quality improvement, calibration, and reviewer training initiatives.

 • Demonstrated experience identifying systematic errors in human-generated annotations, evaluations, or written assessments.
 • Ability to quickly understand and consistently apply detailed policy guidelines.
 • Native-level English fluency and strong written communication skills.
 • Comfort providing clear, direct, and constructive feedback.
 • Strong understanding of US cultural context and communication norms.
 • Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and maintain quality under time pressure.
 • Availability to commit to 40 hours per week; immediate availability is preferred.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 • Experience in AI annotation review, Trust & Safety quality assurance, test engineering, content moderation, or editorial fact-checking.
 • Previous experience with schema validation, policy compliance reviews, annotation completeness checks, or quality auditing.
 • Experience working with sensitive or high-stakes content.
 Importante Note: This project includes sensitive content involving topics such as self-harm, violence, and abuse. Appropriate waivers, support resources, and wellbeing measures will apply.

 Benefits

 • Competitive compensation.

 Application Process 
 • Shortlisted candidates will be reached out.

About Turing:

 Key Responsibilities

 • Identify errors, inconsistencies, missing information, and potential quality issues.
 • Provide structured feedback and final assessments for each task.
 • Follow evaluation guidelines and maintain consistency across all reviews.
 • Document findings clearly and accurately.
 • Collaborate with project and quality teams to resolve queries.
 • Meet assigned productivity, quality, and turnaround-time targets.

 Required Qualifications 
 • Experience in Quality Assurance, data annotation, content evaluation, testing, or a similar role.
 • Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
 • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
 • High attention to detail and ability to identify subtle errors.
 • Comfortable working with AI tools, chatbots, and online platforms.

 Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

 Offer Details:
